System Architecture

How Emowall Protects

Silent detection. Instant verification. Automatic rescue. No button required.

1 Detection Layer

Always active, always listening. Seven sensors work together to detect threats before the child even realizes danger.

  • Sound Detection - Bad words, crying, hitting sounds
  • Smart Watch - Heart rate spike, blood oxygen drop
  • Phone Sensors - Fall detection, sudden impact
  • GPS - Location deviation, unsafe zone entry
  • 7 AI Brains - Analyzing everything silently

2 Verification Chain

When a threat is detected, Emowall silently notifies your trusted network in a cascading priority order.

  • Parent/Guardian - 60 second response window
  • Relative - 30 second window (if parent doesn't respond)
  • School Principal - 30 second window
  • AUTO SOS - If no one responds, authorities alerted instantly

3 Alert System

Simultaneous multi-channel alerts ensure help arrives fast. The attacker never knows - silent mode keeps everything hidden.

  • Live GPS location every 30 seconds
  • WhatsApp alerts to all contacts
  • Telegram + Discord notifications
  • Kerala Police WhatsApp direct
  • Cyber Cell alert
  • Auto call to emergency contact

What's New in 2.0.2+3

Latest Innovations

Two groundbreaking features that expand Emowall's protection beyond physical safety.

🦋 New Feature

Butterfly Guardian

"You are safe here. Whatever you share stays between us."

EmotionDetector silently identifies sadness, anxiety, anger, loneliness, and fear. ButterflyGuardian AI responds with empathy, not scripts. Healing Mode activates with a purple UI and special badge.

Dark Safe Space UI Teal & Purple Bubbles PROTECTED Badge No Data Stored
🐾 New Feature

Animal Alert

"Point. Scan. Stay safe."

Uses your phone camera + AI to identify dangerous animals and insects in real time. Shows danger level, immediate action steps, first aid instructions, and antivenom warnings. Long press SOS for instant emergency alert.

Camera AI Scan Danger Classification First Aid Guide Antivenom Alerts
